name: set-hostprocess-true
description: Fails if a pod, or a container/initContainer/ephemeralContainer within it, sets securityContext.windowsOptions.hostProcess to true. HostProcess containers run with privileged access to the underlying Windows node.
remediation: Avoid setting securityContext.windowsOptions.hostProcess to true unless explicitly required, and restrict its use through admission control (e.g. Pod Security Admission at the baseline/restricted level).
